Subject: [ProcureCo] PO format & annual volume discount activation

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement is ready to move forward but we have two blockers on our side before AP can accept Redwood invoices:

1) PO granularity: our system requires the PO to include a SKU-level breakdown and the Redwood invoice must reference the PO line IDs for each invoice line item.
2) Invoice pulse: our AR team will only accept weekly or monthly statement delivery depending on the PO type; we need confirmation which cadence Redwood will support for multi-entity billing.

Also, our sourcing team indicated the 12% volume discount you quoted is conditional on us sending a single annual PO (blanket), rather than monthly POs. Can you confirm: if we send a blanket PO referencing per-month allocations, will you apply the annual slab discount? If not, what invoicing/PO format triggers the slab?

Attaching our PO template (ProcureCo_PO_Template_v2.docx) and the AP acceptance checklist. If we can get this resolved by Wednesday our legal team will finish the SOW turnaround.

Thanks,
Sarah Lim

Hi Sarah — appreciate the clarity and the template. Short answer: yes, we can support the SKU-level PO references and both weekly/monthly invoice pulses, but there are tradeoffs tied to discount activation that we should align on.

A few clarifying points from our side:
- PO line IDs: we can pass a PO_LINE_ID on each invoice line if ProcureCo includes that field in the PO. Our billing system maps by PO_NUMBER + PO_LINE_ID.
- Blanket PO vs recurring POs: the 12% volume discount you mentioned is applied when the commitment is captured as a single blanket PO with a defined annual commitment and a reference to how monthly quantities will be allocated. If Procurement wants to submit separate monthly POs, we can still offer a partial volume credit but it will default to tiered lookback (applied retroactively) rather than immediate slab pricing.
- Invoice cadence: If you opt for a blanket PO and choose monthly allocations, we can emit monthly invoices (one per month) and tag them to the blanket PO (and to the line IDs). That will satisfy AP's cadence and trigger slab calculation at month-end for the previous month if thresholds are met.

Proposed next steps:
1) Vanessa (cc'd) — can you confirm whether Redwood requires any specific PO XML namespace or just the PO_NUMBER + PO_LINE_ID in a consistent CSV/XML feed from ProcureCo's ERP?
2) Sarah — if you can return the filled template with an example line id and the intended cadence (weekly/monthly), we will produce a sample invoice mapped to your template so AP can validate acceptance.

I'll also attach our pricing slab doc for transparency.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [ProcureCo] PO format & annual volume discount activation

Hi all — quick technical / ops reply from billing:

- PO feed: we support two ingestion paths — a) flat CSV with columns (PO_NUMBER, PO_LINE_ID, SKU, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE) uploaded to our secure SFTP, or b) XML/EDI (we accept a minimal subset: PO_NUMBER and PO_LINE_ID are required). No special namespace required; we parse by headers.
- Invoice tagging: each invoice will include PO_NUMBER and PO_LINE_ID fields in the invoice metadata. AP should be able to match automatically.
- Discount activation: to make the 12% slab effective immediately, accounting requires the blanket PO to include an "Annual Commitment" field and an explicit clause that line items are allocated monthly. If those two are present we will price invoices at the slab rate from first invoice onward. Otherwise we'll run a monthly reconciliation that applies the slab to prior invoices retroactively once thresholds are reached.

Operational ask: Sarah, can your team add the following to the PO template (we've listed the exact field names so mapping is straightforward):
- PO_NUMBER (string)
- PO_LINE_ID (string)
- SKU_CODE (string)
- ALLOCATION_PERIOD (YYYY-MM)
- ANNUAL_COMMITMENT (numeric) — only needed for blanket POs

If you prefer, I can attach a one-page example invoice that mirrors ProcureCo_PO_Template_v2 so AP can try a test match.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual-action-plan-ProcureCo.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

If you can confirm language, we'll get legal to approve quickly.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — hope we can close this week.
